business_summary: Nac Co., Ltd. engages in rental and sale of dust control products in Japan. The company involves in the manufacture and sale of home delivery water, purified water servers, and hypochlorous acid solutions. It also rents and sells dust control products, nursing care products, and welfare equipment, as well as pest control devices, regular cleaning services, and restoration work. In addition, it sells and constructs construction-related know-how products and construction materials to local builders, consulting services, and housing franchise business; involves in the construction contracting for custom-built detached houses; sales of condominiums; and provides related financial services. Further, it manufactures and sells cosmetics, health food, beauty materials, and pharmaceuticals. Additionally, the company offers financial services related to custom-built detached houses; import and sale of alcoholic beverages and Korean food products; and buys and sells used goods. The company was formerly known as Duskin Tsurugawa Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nac Co., Ltd. in 1977. Nac Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
